_comment_pcie_clk: interconnect_top has a SECOND clock (pcie_clk) for the CDC FIFO's read side. OpenLane's default flow assumes one primary clock via CLOCK_PORT -- the second clock and the async-group / multicycle constraints for the gray-code crossing must come from FALLBACK_SDC_FILE (interconnect_constraints.sdc) rather than the top-level JSON keys, since OpenLane's JSON schema doesn't have a native multi-clock declaration.
_comment_pdk: Set PDK/STD_CELL_LIBRARY via the OpenLane invocation (e.g. `flow.tcl -pdk sky130A ...`), not in this file -- keeping this config PDK-agnostic. Depth-16 async FIFO's `mem` array will likely infer as flip-flop-based storage (not a hard macro) at this scale on an open PDK; confirm synthesis mapping in the synth log rather than assuming block RAM.
_comment_not_run_here: This config is a starting point, not a verified-working flow -- actually running OpenLane requires the tool installed with a PDK (sky130/gf180 etc.), which is a large, separate local/CI setup this environment doesn't have. Treat this file as the checked-in starting point for whoever runs the physical flow, not as evidence the design has been placed-and-routed.
